title: Senior Software Engineer - Workflow
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique 
At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. 

How You'll Make an Impact: 

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Workflow Squad, you'll design, build, and operate product capabilities that help Cloudbeds support increasingly complex hospitality operations. This is primarily a backend product engineering role, working in PHP and Java across services, APIs, data, and event-driven systems, with occasional frontend contributions when needed.

You'll take ownership of work from technical design through production, balancing near-term product delivery with the reliability and maintainability of the broader platform. You'll work closely with product and engineering partners to solve ambiguous problems and deliver simple, dependable experiences for our customers.

Our Workflow Squad: 

The Workflow Squad builds product and platform capabilities that coordinate business processes across Cloudbeds products and services. The team works across existing systems to create flexible, reliable experiences that support a wide range of customer needs. You'll join a hands-on, product-minded group that values pragmatic architecture, clear ownership, maintainable code, and strong collaboration across Product, Design, Infrastructure, Security, and Engineering. The squad works AI-first. Claude Code is the default starting point for implementation, and the engineer who ships a change owns it in review and in production.

What You Bring to the Team: 

- Design, build, and operate customer-facing backend services and product capabilities primarily in PHP and Java, with focused frontend contributions when needed

- Build reliable APIs, data models, integrations, asynchronous processes, and event-driven services using PostgreSQL, Kafka, REST, and gRPC

- Own changes end-to-end across application code, service boundaries, infrastructure, and deployment configuration, from technical design through production operation

- Work AI-first, using Claude Code as the default starting point for implementation, and hold what it produces to the same review, testing, and production bar as code you write by hand

- Improve scalability, resilience, performance, security, and maintainability across distributed systems that support customer-critical operations

- Own observability, automated testing, release quality, production support, and incident response as part of the team's on-call rotation

- Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Infrastructure, Security, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic, reliable product solutions

- Contribute as a senior individual contributor through architecture decisions, code reviews, pair programming, documentation, mentoring, and continuous improvement of engineering practices

What Sets You Up for Success: 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production applications, with strong proficiency in PHP and/or Java

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including maintainable architecture, automated testing, debugging, performance, security, and operational reliability

- Solid understanding of API design, relational data modeling, PostgreSQL, distributed systems, and asynchronous or event-driven architecture

- Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar messaging and streaming systems, REST, gRPC, and service integrations

- Experience owning cloud-native delivery and operations, including Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD, observability, and production incident response

- A track record of owning complex work end-to-end, navigating ambiguity, and making pragmatic technical trade-offs

- Comfort working in a polyglot codebase and making focused contributions outside your primary backend stack when the product requires it

- Strong product sense and customer empathy, with the ability to translate business needs into simple, reliable product experiences

- Hands-on experience shipping production code with AI coding agents

- Business-level English fluency, with strong written communication and collaboration skills in a remote, globally distributed team

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $130,000 and $175,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. ( The salary is only for US-based candidates). 

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us 
Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com 

Company Awards : 

- Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025)

- Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025)

- Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)

- Top 10 People’s Choice (2024)

- Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)

Discover our Benefits: 

- Remote First, Remote Always

- PTO in accordance with local labor requirements

- Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month

- Fully Paid Parental Leave

- Home office stipend based on country of residency

- Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University

- Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer 

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion 

Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Technical Architect – Hybrid (Product / Platform) (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission Cloud Native Node.js & AI-enabled Product with SAP Private Cloud Integration | Senior / Principal Level 

As Senior Technical Architect – Hybrid, you own the technical design across our two worlds: the cloud-native, AI-enabled product line built on modern Node.js architectures, and its integration into the SAP Private Cloud platform landscape. 
Your focus is approximately 70% Public Cloud product architecture and 30% SAP Private Cloud platform architecture. You are the architect who makes the hybrid seam work – ensuring that public cloud innovation and the SAP core evolve as one coherent, scalable, and future-proof landscape rather than two disconnected estates. 
Your Responsibilities 

- Cloud-Native Product Architecture (Primary Focus)
Design of microservices architectures on Node.js 
API-first and event-driven architecture concepts 
Definition of service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns 
Ensuring multi-tenant capability and tenant isolation 
Non-functional design: performance, scalability, resilience, cost 
- AI Integration in Product
Technical architecture for AI features in the product 
Integration of LLMs or AI services within defined guardrails 
Design of RAG and agentic patterns over product and platform data 
Performance and cost optimization of AI-driven features 
- Hybrid Integration Architecture (Public ↔ Private Cloud)
Design of the integration layer between cloud-native products and SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud 
API and event contracts across the hybrid boundary (OData, REST, SAP Business Events, Event Mesh) 
Data ownership, consistency, and synchronisation patterns across both estates 
Identity, authorisation, and trust propagation across the hybrid landscape 
- SAP Private Cloud Platform Architecture (Secondary Focus)
Architectural guidance for S/4HANA Private Cloud extensions and side-by-side scenarios 
Enforcement of clean core principles and SAP development standards 
Architectural review of SAP-side designs together with the SAP Private Cloud & SCM architect 
Awareness of core SCM process flows (SD, MM, EWM) as they surface into product capabilities 
- DevOps & Deployment Architecture
Collaboration with infrastructure and deployment engineers across both estates 
Architecture design for containerization and cloud deployment 
CI/CD and environment strategy spanning public and private cloud pipelines 
- Design Governance
Creation of HLD, SDD, and TDD up to epic level 
Technical review and sign-off responsibility in the Architecture Board 
Translation of enterprise guardrails into actionable design standards for teams 
Organizational Context 

- Embedded in the Engineering function 
- Senior / Principal Level 
- Part of the Architecture Board 
- Operates within guardrails defined by the Enterprise Architect 
- Works in close tandem with the Technical Architect – Public Cloud and the Technical Architect – SAP Private Cloud & SCM 

Your profile - Several years of experience as an architect in cloud-native environments 
- Strongexpertisein Node.js 
- Experience with microservices and API architectures 
- Strong understanding of event-driven systems 
- Experience integrating AI into software products 
- Cloud architecture experience (containers, orchestration, scaling) 
- Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud and clean core extension patterns 
- Proventrack recorddesigning integration between cloud-native applications and an ERP core 
- High technical credibility with senior engineers in both cloud-native and SAP teams Plus 
- Experience with SAP BTP and SAP CAP (Node.js/CDS) 
- Experience with RISE with SAP or hyperscaler -hosted SAP environments 
- Exposure to SCM processes and SAP modules (SD, MM, EWM) 
- Experience with ABAP / RAP at review level echnology Stack 
- Public Cloud & Product (≈70%)
Node.js, TypeScript, microservices, API-first design 
Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes / Kyma), Cloud Foundry 
Event-Driven Architecture, SAP Event Mesh, SAP Business Events 
CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability 
- SAP Platform & Extensions (≈30%)
SAP BTP, SAP CAP (Node.js/CDS) 
S/4HANA Private Cloud and Public Cloud side-by-side extensions 
Clean Core OData APIs, ABAP / RAP (at review level) 
- Data & AI
HANA Cloud (HDI, Vector Engine) 
Generative AI / SAP AI Core, RAG, LLM integration 
LangChain / LangGraph, agentic orchestration 
- Infrastructure & Security
Multi-Tenant Architecture 
XSUAA / IAS / IPS, identity federation across hybrid landscapes 
CI/CD (SAP and non-SAP toolchains) 
AI Readiness 

We expect our architects to work with AI, not just design for it. We assess AI readiness on two levels. 
- General AI Working Practice
Habitual, critical use of AI assistants in daily engineering and design work 
Ability to judge where AI output is trustworthy and where it must be verified 
Awareness of data protection, IP, and confidentiality boundaries when using AI tools 
Willingness to share prompts, patterns, and lessons learned with the wider engineering organisation 
- Role-Specific AI Usage
AI-assisted architecture work: option analysis, trade-off exploration, design review support 
AI-assisted generation and maintenance of HLD, SDD, and TDD artefacts 
Use of AI coding assistants for prototypes, spikes, and reference implementations 
Designing AI-native product capabilities: RAG over product and SAP data, agentic workflows, guardrails and evaluation 
Assessing AI features for cost, latency, and operational risk before they enter the architecture

Why us? You hold the hybrid landscape together. You build the foundation for scalable public cloud products, enable AI-native capabilities and ensure the SAP core and cloud-native product portfolio evolve as one. Your role enables innovation to scale at pace while keeping the platform stable, governed, and coherent.

title: Kepler | Full Stack Engineer | New York, NY | ONSITE | $230K-$260K + equity
description:
Kepler | Full Stack Engineer | New York, NY | ONSITE | $230K-$260K + equity
We're building the trust layer for AI in high-stakes industries. https://kepler.ai LLMs hallucinate, so they can't be the thing producing your numbers. In Kepler, the LLM orchestrates (decides what data to gather, what to compute, how to structure the output), but the model never touches the data itself. Every actual value flows through deterministic code pipelines with provenance metadata back to source. Verification loops cross-check outputs before users see them. We started in finance because tolerance for wrong answers is zero. First product is a research platform for buy-side analysts: pull comparables, build models, research filings. Same architecture extends to chemicals, legal, healthcare. Models are commoditizing fast; the trust layer is what's missing. If you want the deeper architecture writeup, Anthropic just published a case study on Kepler: https://claude.com/blog/how-kepler-built-verifiable-ai-for-f... What you'd build: - Source-explorer UI that traces any value back to its exact origin in the original document - Extraction pipeline for a data source we don't yet handle, with provenance and verification from day one - Agent orchestrator that handles partial failures so a bad extraction from one source doesn't block parallel work - Verification rules that cross-check values across multiple sources and surface conflicts with provenance on both sides Stack: Rust backend (orchestration, extraction, computation), TypeScript/React frontend, PostgreSQL, AWS. Model-agnostic, currently Claude + GPT. We don't require Rust experience; we hire on fundamentals. Looking for 5 years production experience, strong in TypeScript/React, comfortable in backend work. Bonus if you've built systems where correctness mattered (payments, data infra, healthcare, anything where a wrong output has consequences). Distributed systems basics: concurrency, fault tolerance, retries, idempotency. Founding team is 40+ combined years at Palantir building Foundry's core systems (Ontology, Fusion, Workshop, FoundryML). CEO scaled a data company to $15M ARR, sold it, then ran Business Engineering at Citadel. Backed by founders of OpenAI, Meta AI Research, MotherDuck, dbt Labs. In-office NYC. Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/kepler-ai/52624a4e-33e3-4f16-8028-0... , or email me: eddie.hammond@kepler.ai

title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrated Workflows
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Integrated Workflows team exists to expand Mural's value by embedding it seamlessly into the essential business workflows our customers already live in. We connect Mural to the tools that teams rely on every day, from the systems of record where work gets tracked to the places conversations happen and the surfaces content moves through.

That is what integrations unlock, and it is the most interesting thing about this team. When Mural can reach the work happening everywhere else, a canvas stops being a snapshot of one meeting and becomes a live surface for how a team operates: real context pulled in, real decisions pushed back out, nobody retyping a status update or hunting for the current version. A workshop stops ending at the wall of sticky notes and starts ending in tracked, owned, moving work. That is when collaboration gets genuinely effective, and building toward it is the point of everything we do.

Underneath all of that, we build the integration platform: the shared frameworks, services, and patterns that let any team at Mural ship a connected experience without starting from scratch. Our mission: to make Mural a natural part of daily work. We measure success by how indispensable Mural becomes inside real customer workflows, not by the number of integrations we ship.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Integrated Workflows team, you'll own significant parts of how Mural connects to the outside world. You'll design and build integrations that are reliable, secure, and genuinely used, and you'll turn one-off connector work into integration platform capabilities the rest of the company can build on.

This role sits at the intersection of product and platform. You'll work directly against third-party APIs and SDKs with all the ambiguity that entails: shifting contracts, rate limits, auth models, partner review processes. At the same time you'll keep our own abstractions clean and our public API stable for the developers who depend on it.

Senior Engineers at Mural lead, design, and implement complex technical projects, contribute to team and company-wide processes and culture, and provide mentorship and support for early-career colleagues.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- 
Build and evolve two-way sync with the systems of record where customer work lives (Jira, Linear, Asana, and others), so decisions made on the canvas become tracked work and stay in sync as that work changes

- 
Design, build, and maintain integrations across the Microsoft ecosystem (Teams, Outlook, Office), video conferencing platforms, and third-party notification targets such as Slack and Teams

- 
Build and evolve the integration platform: the shared frameworks, services, and patterns other Mural teams use to ship their own connected experiences

- 
Own the content pathways in and out of Mural, including the import and image panels, third-party image APIs such as Unsplash, copy/paste to and from outside Mural, file upload handling, iFrame embedding, self-serve PDF to Mural conversion, and Mural exports and downloads

- 
Partner across teams on shared boundaries and hold up your side of those contracts, including render for exports, the notification engine, and company-level migration

- 
Maintain and support our public API for existing third-party developers, with the backwards-compatibility discipline a published interface demands

- 
Lead projects end to end, from research, design, and POC through execution, release, and iteration

- 
Build flexible and maintainable solutions while being accountable for quality, performance, reliability, and the security posture of everything crossing our system boundary

- 
Use AI tools as part of your fundamental workflows

- 
Design, plan, and implement automated testing and documentation strategies, including for the failure modes that only show up when someone else's API misbehaves

- 
Elevate the team's skills and knowledge by participating in technical designs and talks, and by reviewing and helping improve your and your colleagues' code

- 
Contribute to constantly improving the team's processes and best practices

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 
Fluency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and experience with technologies such as React, Node.js, or other modern frameworks

- 
Hands-on experience integrating with third-party APIs and platforms: OAuth and token lifecycle management, webhooks, rate limiting and backoff, pagination, versioning, and graceful degradation when an upstream service fails

- 
5+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

- 
Strong track record of designing and delivering scalable, high-performance systems

- 
An outcome-oriented and highly-experimental interest in AI-driven development practices

- 
Proven experience planning technical projects and delivering new systems and features iteratively, with a focus on delivering value to customers quickly

- 
Strong collaboration and communication skills, able to lead technical discussions and navigate trade-offs effectively

- 
Experience working in high-growth, fast-paced environments or startups is a plus

- 
Experience building against Microsoft Teams or Office add-in SDKs, or shipping through a partner marketplace or app review process

- 
Experience designing and maintaining a public developer API

- 
Experience with Python

- 
Familiarity with secure file handling at scale, including permissions checks, malware scanning, and content validation on upload

- 
Experience with content migration or format conversion between products, and the fidelity problems that come with it

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Equal Opportunity

description: Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer. Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce .

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. 

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering 

- Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.

- Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.

- Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.

- Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability 

- Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.

- Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.

- Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution 

- Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.

- Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

- Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.

- Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

- Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.

- Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

- Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.

- Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

- Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.

- Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

- Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.

- Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.

- 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.

- Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.

- Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.

- Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.

- Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.

- Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.

- You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.

- Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.

- Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.

- Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.

- Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

- Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.

- You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Team Lead AI Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
We're digitizing the construction industry – are you in? At VESTIGAS, you build the digital backbone of the construction supply chain. We turn purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices into a digital, legally compliant platform used in everyday operations by construction companies and suppliers. You’ll work on a product with real market traction in the DACH mid-market, ship iteratively, and take ownership of solutions that must work in the field—not just in theory.

Your Role As Team Lead – AI Engineering, you'll own the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform end to end – from pipeline design to production deployment. You bring prior leadership experience and are ready to lead a team of AI engineers: setting technical direction, growing your team's capabilities, and making sure the team consistently delivers reliable, scalable AI systems.

The Technical Challenge Your team will tackle problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough." This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the team navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters.

Your Mission - Lead and long-term grow a team of AI engineers, providing both strategical technical direction and people leadership
- Own MLOps processes and infrastructure, ensuring our AI systems are reliable, scalable, and secure
- Drive the design and implementation of advanced AI features, partnering closely with engineering and product leadership to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines
- Set the bar for accuracy, efficiency, and uncertainty estimation of our AI features through rigorous testing practices
- Ensure the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and drive the build of new ones from scratch
- Translate customer needs into technical priorities and represent AI engineering in strategic product and sales discussions
- Establish and evolve engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices across the team
- Coach and develop your team members, supporting their technical and professional growth
- Champion the use of modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor across the team

Your Profile - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
- 5+ years of experience in AI engineering and at least 1+ years in a leading position, including end-to-end lifecycle management and MLOps
- Proven experience leading or managing a technical team, with strong people-leadership skills
- Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
- Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
- A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
- A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
- Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
- Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
- Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week

Your Benefits - Real ownership instead of micromanagement. You shape, you decide, and you see the impact of your work directly in the market.
- Direct line to founders and leadership. Flat hierarchies are our everyday reality – short paths, fast decisions.
- AI-First workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor & co. are standard tools for us. We expect and support their use.
- Hybrid work with an office in the heart of Munich, just around the corner from Theresienwiese. Flexible setup with regular office presence – because we believe the best ideas happen in person.
- EGYM Wellpass or BahnCard, corporate benefits, team events, annual offsites.
- Fair, competitive compensation.

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Commerce
description:
AI at Zapier 

At Zapier , we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently .

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process , including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Job Posted: April 29, 2026

Updated: June 19, 2026

Location: Americas - North, Central and South America, EMEA, APAC

Hi there!

Zapier's mission is to make automation work for everyone. That mission is funded by revenue — and every dollar of it flows through our Commerce Zone. We build and operate the infrastructure behind billing, subscriptions, payments, pricing, entitlements, and checkout across everything Zapier ships: self-serve plans, enterprise contracts, and ecosystem offerings. When a customer upgrades, renews, changes plans, or pays an invoice, our systems make it happen — correctly, instantly, and at scale.

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to own the technical vision and long-term architecture for the Commerce Zone. You'll define the pricing primitives, service boundaries, and data models that let Zapier ship pricing and packaging changes in days instead of months — while keeping every dollar accounted for accurately. That means designing the framework and abstractions product teams plug into so they can launch new SKUs without becoming billing experts, building configuration-driven infrastructure for pricing experimentation, and ensuring the platform evolves without foundational rewrites.

This is production-critical, finance-grade infrastructure where correctness is non-negotiable. You'll drive alignment across teams in a space defined by high ambiguity and competing constraints, working closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Sales. The role is particularly exciting because decisions here ripple across Zapier — shaping how the company monetizes its next phase of growth.

- 
Our Commitment to Applicants 

- 
Culture and Values at Zapier 

- 
Zapier Guide to Remote Work 

- 
Zapier Code of Conduct 

- 
Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier 

About You 

- 
Proven engineering impact: You've driven outcomes in complex, production systems at scale — shipping projects that delivered measurable improvements in environments where requirements shifted under you. You separate essential from accidental complexity, make tradeoffs explicit, and use data to inform decisions without becoming paralyzed by it. Many strong candidates have 8+ years of experience, but we hire for impact and capability, not tenure.

- 
Billing/payments/monetization domain experience: You bring strong domain knowledge in billing systems, subscription management, payment processing, or financial platforms. You understand metered billing, pricing models, entitlements, revenue recognition, and the operational complexity of supporting enterprise customers. You know that billing isn't just a backend problem — it touches sales, finance, support, and product, and you've navigated that reality.

- 
API, platform, and performance expertise: You've designed and built APIs that serve multiple consumers — internal teams, external partners, and user-facing products — and you know how to evolve systems without breaking existing integrations. You have a track record of identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks through profiling, caching, database optimization, and delivering measurable improvements that impact user experience and conversion.

- 
Outcome-driven and customer-focused: You care deeply about the problems our customers are trying to solve and define success by the results they achieve — not the elegance of the technical solution. You fall in love with the problem, not your first implementation, and are willing to rethink or pivot when it better serves the customer and the business.

- 
Cross-team leadership and proactive ownership: You've led technical initiatives that span multiple teams and operate with end-to-end ownership. You gather requirements, surface risks early, align stakeholders, and drive ambiguous problems through to measurable outcomes. You're a trusted partner to Engineering, Product, and Design leadership — helping shape roadmaps, translating business strategy into technical direction, and amplifying other engineers by raising standards and building durable foundations that create leverage across teams.

- 
AI fluency: You use AI coding tools as a regular part of your workflow and have a point of view on where they accelerate delivery and where human judgment is non-negotiable. In a high-correctness domain like payments and billing, you know the difference between automating boilerplate and trusting AI with revenue logic — and you bring that judgment to the engineers you work with.

- 
Comfort with complexity: You're at home in large, mature codebases — you know how to navigate a monolith, find the right leverage points, and make meaningful progress without waiting for a clean slate.

Things You’ll Do 

- 
Serve as a technical leader within the Commerce Zone: You’ll operate as part of the zone’s leadership team, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Design to shape strategy and roadmap decisions. You’ll translate business context into technical direction—and ensure engineering tradeoffs are clearly understood at the business level.

- 
Shape the long-term platform vision: You’ll define and evolve the architectural direction of the Commerce Zone, balancing near-term delivery with long-term durability, extensibility, and operational excellence.

- 
Lead high-impact technical initiatives: You’ll drive the strategic evolution of our monetization platform—decoupling billing from account systems, clarifying system boundaries, and consolidating pricing infrastructure. You’ll build flexible, configurable foundations that enable fast Pricing and Packaging experimentation and seamless launch moments across the customer lifecycle, while supporting clean, reliable data for Finance and Pricing & Packaging.

- 
Own and strengthen revenue-critical systems: You’ll be responsible for systems across the Commerce Zone—Billing, Pricing, Payments, Checkout, and Entitlements—ensuring they are resilient, observable, and correct. You’ll raise the bar on proactive detection, safe rollback mechanisms, and revenue accuracy—catching issues before customers do. You’ll systematically reduce structural and technical debt, eliminate recurring operational pain points, and strengthen architectural foundations to prevent revenue-impacting incidents before they emerge.

- 
Guide high-impact technical decisions: You’ll influence API design, data modeling, caching strategies, and system architecture—optimizing for scalability, developer experience, and rapid pricing and packaging iteration.

- 
Partner deeply across Zapier: You’ll collaborate closely with Pricing & Packaging, Product, and Design teams to drive ARR growth and craft seamless, intuitive, and lovable monetization journeys for self-serve, enterprise, and ecosystem customers. You’ll also work with Support and Operations to ensure robust admin tooling and exceptional customer experiences across upgrades, billing changes, and subscription management.

- 
Drive measurable improvements: You’ll identify performance bottlenecks and deliver optimizations that show up in the metrics—reduced latency, improved reliability, stronger customer experiences, and improved conversion and retention.

- 
Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar: You’ll share patterns and tooling, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and grow engineering capability across the zone. You’ll be a go-to resource for engineers tackling complex monetization and platform challenges.

- 
Champion documentation and developer experience: You’ll ensure our systems are well-documented and easy to adopt, reducing friction and accelerating development across the organization.

How to Apply 

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here .

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com .

Application Deadline: 

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

fractile.ai - AI hardware, backed by Founders Fund - London (UK) - Onsite ABOUT FRACTILE
Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the amount of time they take to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. We’ve recently raised $220M from Founders Fund and Accel and the most important work lies ahead. Come and join the mission! THE ROLE
As a Software Engineer you will be a core part of our technical team working alongside the hardware, software and research teams to solve cutting-edge problems in AI hardware, ranging from verification to simulation, alongside the best of the best (DeepMind, Apple, Meta…). ABOUT YOU
1) You have exceptional ability. We look for pivotal IC contributions that solved the hardest problems in big tech companies or hedge funds; competitive hackathons, International Olympiad medals, or rank highly in other competitions like advent of code 2. You are a top engineer. We are not looking for specific languages or technologies - you will be a master of several, you excel at algorithmic skills and solving problems logically in any programming language. And you are very comfortable learning new skills on the fly. You like to work in Python and C++ 3. It’s likely you have several years of professional experience, but we will make exceptions for the right candidate 4. You want to work with the best. And you are excited to work in chips, solving the hardest problems at the frontier of AI WHAT WE OFFER
1. Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
2. A very cool office with London's best views
3. Private medical insurance and pension benefits If this sounds like you, ping carmen@fractile.ai
